response.sql: WITH matched_records AS (SELECT tr.trdref, t.tradereg, t.tradekind FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), trader_type_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN tradekind IS NULL THEN 'No type' ELSE tradekind END as trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tradereg) as trader_count FROM matched_records GROUP BY CASE WHEN tradekind IS NULL THEN 'No type' ELSE tradekind END), stats AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(trader_count AS REAL)) as avg_count, SUM(trader_count) as total_count FROM trader_type_counts) SELECT ttc.trader_type, ttc.trader_count, CAST(ttc.trader_count AS REAL) / stats.total_count as pct_of_total, ttc.trader_count - stats.avg_count as above_average FROM trader_type_counts ttc CROSS JOIN stats WHERE ttc.trader_count > stats.avg_count AND stats.avg_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ttc.trader_type
